page: Microsoft Azure M416-208ms_v2 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the MSv2 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features dedicated CPU allocation powered by Intel Xeon 8280L processors operating at 2.7 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 104 physical cores and 208 vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 11400.0 GB of system memory, yielding 54.81 GB of RAM per physical core. Local storage consists of 8389 GB, and the instance is Premium Storage capable. No GPUs are included in this configuration, and it comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data reveals a significant divergence between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng single-core CPU performance and single-threaded gzip compression, fall into the bottom 25% tier. Conversely, multi-core and parallelized execution metrics are highly competitive. The server achieves top 10% tier results in stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, bzip3 multi-threaded decompression, and PassMark CPU physics tests. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, with cached small-block read-only bandwidth reaching 10444.18 GB/sec and uncached large-block write bandwidth at 305.41 GB/sec, both placing in the top 10% tier. Redis SET operations also perform in the top 10% tier, executing 159.37 million operations per second.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this server represents a massive resource density profile designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. The high ratio of memory to CPU cores makes it appropriate for large-scale in-memory databases, heavy database operations, and complex multi-threaded data processing tasks. However, the weak single-core performance suggests it is inefficient for workloads reliant on single-threaded execution speeds. Appropriate workloads include large-scale Redis deployments, enterprise database hosting, and memory-bound parallel computing tasks.
description: Microsoft Azure M416-208ms_v2 is a memory-optimized server in the MSv2 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8280L processor with 104 physical cores and 208 vCPUs on an x86_64 architecture. The server is configured with 11400.0 GB of RAM and 8389 GB of local storage, with Premium Storage capability. Benchmark results show a distinct performance tradeoff: single-core performance is weak, placing in the bottom 25%, while multi-core and memory bandwidth metrics consistently rank in the top 10%. Specifically, it achieves top-tier results in multi-core stress-ng, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and Redis SET operations, which reach 159.37 million operations per second. This profile makes the server highly effective for memory-intensive enterprise workloads, large-scale in-memory databases, and parallelized data processing, while being less efficient for single-threaded tasks.
